current_evidence_lines: IEA GO_REF:0000120 (RHEA:23252 / EC 1.17.4.1); IGI PMID:9315670 x2; IGI PMID:9315671; IMP PMID:9315671
lead_action: Remove the enables qualifier; keep the term only as contributes_to
rationale: Rnr4 has no di-iron site (3 of 6 ligands lost, pocket filled by Tyr223 at 2.13 A from the mapped metal position in PDB 1JK0) and purified Y4 has no measurable activity (PMID:10535923). The enables lines come from reaction mapping onto the complex EC number and from genetic suppression/essentiality data that cannot assign the activity to a specific subunit.

go_name: ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase activity, thioredoxin disulfide as acceptor
current_evidence_lines: IDA PMID:10535923; IDA PMID:10716984; IMP PMID:16285741; RCA GO_REF:0000123
rationale: Rnr4 is an obligate part of the beta beta' subunit whose holo form has specific activity 0.8-1.3 micromol/min/mg (PMID:11526232). contributes_to is the GO relation designed for a subunit supplying part of a complex activity without carrying the catalytic site.

current_evidence_lines: IEA GO_REF:0000002 from InterPro IPR012348 (ferritin-like di-iron domain)
rationale: The signature matches the ferritin-like fold, which Rnr4 keeps, while the di-iron site that makes the fold redox active is destroyed. Fold-based IEA contradicted by structure.

current_evidence_lines: IDA PMID:10716984; IPI PMID:10716984; IDA PMID:11526233; IPI PMID:9315670
rationale: Direct structural and biochemical evidence: the Y2Y4 heterodimer was crystallised (PDB 1JK0, PMID:11526233) and genomically tagged beta or beta' isolates a 1:1 complex (PMID:16285741).

lead_action: Retain; this is the most informative MF directly supported
rationale: The crystal structure defines a heterodimer interface of mouse-R2-like size; superposition here gives 1.12 A core RMSD over 242 CA pairs. Preferred over GO:0005515 protein binding as the MF statement.

lead_action: Candidate new BP annotation (lead only), IMP/IDA from PMID:21931161, PMID:10535923, PMID:16285741
rationale: Rnr4 is required for iron loading into nascent Rnr2 and for diferric-tyrosyl radical formation; rnr4 deletion lowers Y radical content 15-fold. GO definition: any process leading to the attainment of the full functional capacity of a protein. No child term exists for di-iron cofactor assembly, so a new child could be proposed.
Covers the stabilisation of the holo heterodimer reported in PMID:16489218. Weaker than GO:0051604 because the measured defect in rnr4 mutants is cofactor loading, not complex formation per se.
